result.summary: Found 1 major visual layout issue in the bottom navigation area.

issues.description: The bottom navigation is clipped by the screen edge and overlaps the system home indicator. The search and bookmark icons are partially obscured, and the profile icon is cut off at the bottom.
issues.suggestion: Respect the device safe-area inset and increase the bottom navigation bar height/padding so all navigation icons remain fully visible above the system gesture indicator.
